content:
mika: Heads-up — Lumenia (POC) emailed procurement asking for SOC2 Type II cover page, an ISO27001 excerpt, and a signed pen-test attestation they can include in their vendor risk portal. They also want to run an external scan against our staging.
jamal: I can handle the attestation. we typically provide a short signed letter + statement of scanning cadence. do they want the full pentest report or a redacted summary?
mika: their checklist says 'signed attestation or redacted report'. procurement prefers vendor-signed doc only.
elena: technical constraints: we can allow a scheduled external scan but need a formal request with scope. standard lead time is 72h for firewall changes and an additional 24h for validation. auth scans require a temporary test API key and a kill-switch contact.
mika: timeline: they want everything by COB Friday to meet a vendor cut-off. realistic?
jelamal: (typo) sorry, jamal: Friday is tight. if they accept shared staging + no dedicated infra, we might make it. dedicated staging for isolated scans will add uplift to quote and ~5 business days setup.
jamal: pricing note: dedicated staging -> bill as a short-term reserved instance. I'll draft a provisional line item in case they push for isolation.
melena: (typo) elena: upload rules: do NOT email reports. use presigned S3 link or place into the secure evidence drive (SSO only). if they insist on dropping a file, open a support ticket for temporary SSO access.
mika: can we sign their standard "vendor attestation" PDF instead of our template? legal usually reviews. any objections?
elena: legal/security won't sign new liability clauses. we can review theirs and suggest edits. request comes to legal@redwood and security@redwood for sign-off.
jamal: attestation content we provide should include: 1) statement of external scan cadence 2) redaction policy (no PoCs, no internal IPs) 3) data retention for POC staging (logs kept <=7 days) 4) contact for scan kill-switch.
mika: please drop the attestation template and the upload instructions in this thread. also include a quick bulleted checklist for procurement.
security-bot: attestation template uploaded: https://redwood-internal.s3.amazonaws.com/templates/attestation_poc_template.docx (access: SSO)
elena: checklist (minimal) -> 1) SOC2 Type II cover page (PDF) 2) ISO27001 Annex-A excerpt (PDF) 3) signed pen-test attestation (PDF) 4) NDA if they need full pentest report 5) allowed hosts + ports + time window 6) contact for kill-switch.
elena: example host entry for their request: ``hosts: staging.lumenia.poc.rw-example.net``
jamal: redaction guidance: remove any server-side logs with token/session IDs, strip PoC exploit code and internal ticket links. provide a brief summary of findings instead.
mika: i'll ask procurement whether they accept our template or will upload their form. if they send their form, i'll route to legal.
jamal: I'll prep a quick dedicated-staging estimate in case they push for isolation. posting estimate here later today.
elena: if they plan auth scanning, we need the exact endpoints and an app-level test key. auth scans require an extra 24h to provision creds.
mika: Assigned -> jamal: attestation + price estimate; elena: staging schedule + upload flow; jamal/elena/legal: loop for any edits to their doc. I'll update the customer and confirm timeline. :thumbsup: 
security-bot: reminder: when complete, attach signed attestation to ticket #P-7788 and mark evidence folder as "shared-with-procurement".
